Our mission is to take away technology headaches allowing our clients to focus on their core business. Working hours Internal IT is a 24/7 team although working hours are primarily Monday through Friday, 8am to 5pm local time. Occasional after hours and/or weekend work will be required based on ongoing initiatives and special requests. Participate in a rotating on-call schedule (afterhours and weekends) Location requirements: Greenwood Village, CO - Hybrid role with 3 days in the office each week Why this job is exciting Feeling stagnated in your current IT role? You won’t at NexusTek - no two days are alike in the MSP world! This is a fast-paced, ever-changing IT position. You will work hands-on with the latest technology in multiple systems and tools. All while engaging our internal users in the process to understand their technology needs and enhance their technology efficiencies. Who you are Proactive and independent technical expert who performs a variety of tier I, tier II, and tier III technical support responsibilities, requiring a thorough working knowledge of information technology and remote desktop support. You are a skilled communicator on all levels and dedicated to providing top-notch customer service. Your meticulous attention to detail is shown through your timekeeping, documentation, and execution of the technical work. You Know How To: Serve as the first point of contact for customers seeking technical assistance via tickets generated by e-mail and phone calls. Demonstrate knowledge and experience in information technology and administration. Maintain strict confidentiality and security ofthe internalcustomer supportandtickets, records, and sensitive information in accordance withcompany policies. Assist users that may be locked out of computing devices, cloud services, or other applications. Direct unresolved issues to the next level of support personnel. Maintain the highest possible level of customer service. Work with vendors to provide internal users with updates on ISP outages or vendor support issues. Assist with the upkeep of internal environment documentation. Identify and contribute to automating tasks and processes. Work with the HR team and managers of various levels on the onboarding and offboarding of NexusTek employees and contractors. Willingness to learn new technologies, systems, and tools. Asset management – provide adequate laptops and required equipment to new employees, replace/refresh gear for existing employees, and ensure that equipment is returned by former employees. Microsoft Windows Server 2008 to present Microsoft Windows 10 to present Microsoft SQL Server 2008 to present. Active Directory, DNS, DHCP VMWare ESXi 5.5 to present Veeam Backup & Replication Email filtering and encryption such as Barracuda & Avanan /Checkpoint Cloud and virtualization-based technologies, Azure, GCP, AWS. review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator/Sr. Site Support Specialist
review_candidates.description: Overview JOB TITLE: Systems Administrator / Sr. Site Support Specialist AGENCY SUPPORTED: Department of Defense (DoD) – DISA NetOps / GSM-O II (Leidos), supporting the DoD Mobility Classified Capability (DMCC) program LOCATION: 3326 General Hudnell Drive, San Antonio, TX 78226 (100% Onsite) POSITION TYPE: Full-time; permanent 3rd shift, Sunday–Wednesday, 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM (4x10 schedule) CLEARANCE REQUIREMENT: Active DoD Secret clearance required prior to start. DoD-8570 IAT Level II certification (Security+ CE) required within 6 months of hire date. No additional onboarding requirements beyond these. ITC Federal is an information technology and consulting company focused on servicing the needs of the Federal Government. ITC’s mission is to apply earned expertise in information technology and information assurance/security to assist this client in achieving its mission. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment. The Digital Modernization Sector within Leidos supports the DoD Mobility Classified Capability (DMCC) program as part of GSM-O II in San Antonio, TX, providing DISA NetOps / Tier-III HelpDesk support on a fully-billable enterprise IT contract. The team manages an infrastructure comprised of Windows servers, Red Hat Enterprise Linux servers, network appliances, and applications supporting voice and data services, ensuring secure, reliable, and uninterrupted availability of the DoD’s secure mobile device capability . The Systems Administrator/Sr. Site Support Specialist will be responsible for Tier-III HelpDesk support, handling service inquiries, troubleshooting complex problems, performing technical software configuration, and providing customer support. This role requires strong knowledge of Windows and Linux server operations, sustainment, and management, working as part of a Network Operations team responsible for a variety of servers, network appliances, and applications. This is a 100% onsite position at the San Antonio, TX site, working a permanent 3rd shift schedule (Sunday–Wednesday, 8:00 PM–6:00 AM). Responsibilities Support the DISA NetOps / Tier-III HelpDesk for the DoD Mobility Classified Capability (DMCC) program under GSM-O II, handling service inquiries, troubleshooting complex problems, performing technical software configuration, and providing customer support. Monitor and maintain an enterprise services environment consisting of Windows servers, Red Hat Enterprise Linux servers, and network appliances. Assist mission partners with mobile device VPN connectivity debugging, user account and device management, and troubleshooting system/service access issues. Perform configuration updates and maintenance activities to patch, secure, and maintain systems. Respond to, and help analyze, issues that degrade system or network performance to minimize downtime. Address moderately complex technical issues using internal SOPs and collaboration with team members. Help create and update documentation for common issues and processes to contribute to the team’s knowledge base. Provide input on ways to optimize processes and improve the efficiency of the environment. Support occasional after-hours maintenance and be available for 2-hour onsite call-back support for critical issues. Qualifications REQUIRED: Bachelor’s degree and 2-4 years of related experience, or Master’s degree with a minimum of 2 years of related experience. Additional experience, education, and training may be considered in lieu of degree. Active DoD Secret clearance or higher. DoD-8570 IAT Level II certification (Security+ CE) required within 6 months of hire date. Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, and DNS. Experience with Linux (RHEL 8 or 9). Networking experience using Cisco, Aruba, and/or Juniper devices. Experience with Cybersecurity tools and scanning (ACAS, Tenable, or Ansible). Experience troubleshooting issues with software applications, networking, Windows OS, and Linux OS. Experience performing system administration tasks — installing, maintaining, monitoring, recovering, rebuilding, upgrading, and patching. Experience researching technical solutions beyond internal SOPs. Strong knowledge of systems and networking software, hardware, and protocols. Willingness to work with multiple technologies and be open to learning new technologies. Motivated self-starter with strong work ethic and ability to work with minimal supervision in the fulfillment of daily operations and sustainment activities. Ability to demonstrate good judgement, professionalism, and communicate clearly (verbal and written). Strong problem solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills. Desired Expert knowledge of security, storage, data protection, and disaster recovery protocols. Experience configuring and maintaining network devices — switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs. Experience with scripting or automation tools. Experience with SCCM (Systems Center Configuration Manager). Experience with VMWare — ESX/ESXi, vCenter, vSphere — or equivalent virtualization platforms. Experience with SQL, MySQL, SELinux. Knowledge of networking concepts such as the OSI Model, LAN/WAN, IPv4/IPv6, subnetting, and VLANs. Experience maintaining systems and services in an air-gapped environment. Knowledge of security policies such as DISA STIGs and general vulnerability management. Certifications with major system vendors such as Microsoft, Red Hat, VMware, Cisco, Juniper, or Aruba. Experience in multiple OS platforms with strong emphasis on Linux (CentOS, Red Hat, Ubuntu), Mac OS X, and Windows systems. In-depth knowledge of the TCP/IP protocol suite, security architecture, and securing/hardening Operating Systems, Networks, Databases, and Applications. Experience with Tier 2 system administration. Experience with server patch management methodologies. Excellent customer service skills complemented by an ability to listen to and interpret client requests. Strong oral and written communication skills. Track record of working effectively within a team, and supporting peers toward improved processes and results. Experience with support ticket management systems. Work Environment And Physical Demands This position is 100% onsite at the San Antonio, TX site (3326 General Hudnell Drive, San Antonio, TX 78226), working a permanent 3rd shift schedule, Sunday–Wednesday, 8:00 PM–6:00 AM. ITC Federal is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any application for employment on the basis of age, race, color, gender, national origin, religion, creed, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military status, disability, or sex including pregnancy and childbirth or related medical condition or on any other basis prohibited by law.

review_candidates.title: IT Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: Job Description We are hiring an IT Systems Administrator (Tier 2) to deliver high-quality technical support for internal users and managed services clients. You will handle escalations from Tier 1, own tickets through resolution, and collaborate with Tier 3, Centralized Services, and Monitoring teams. Perks & Benefits Competitive pay Health Saving Account, Flexible Saving Account, Employee Assistance Program Annual Education Allowance Generous Referral Program Fun and collaborative company culture with lots of team-building events Discounted hotel stays in multiple locations through our Hospitality brand. What You Will Do Resolve Tier 1&2 incidents and requests end-to-end (ownership, communication, documentation). Troubleshoot Windows 10/11 and macOS endpoints, laptops, peripherals, printers, common business applications, and remote access tools. Microsoft 365 support: Exchange Online basics (mail flow checks, shared mailboxes, permissions), Teams troubleshooting, SharePoint/OneDrive sync and access issues, licensing/user administration. Identity support: Active Directory and Entra ID fundamentals (account lockouts, group membership, access issues, MFA resets, sign-in troubleshooting; conditional access awareness); user account creation, updates, onboarding/offboarding, and decommissioning. Network troubleshooting: DNS/DHCP, VPN, firewalls, switches, Wi-Fi connectivity, VoIP phone systems, basic routing/switching concepts; escalate complex network issues appropriately. Server troubleshooting (basic–intermediate): Windows Server services and event logs, file/print access, patching impacts; basic virtualization awareness and escalation readiness. Support mobile devices (phones and tablets): setup, provisioning, configuration, data transfers, and decommissioning. Support boardroom and meeting room equipment: video conferencing hardware/software, TVs, projectors, and audio systems. Support/troubleshoot IP-based and non-traditional IT systems (e.g., IP cameras/CCTV/NVR access and connectivity, building access control systems/cards/fobs, building automation and audio systems, timecard systems, EV systems, digital signage, PoE basics) and coordinate vendor/Tier 3 escalations when needed. Monitor and manage system alerts, including outage/offline events across servers, network, software, hardware, and cybersecurity. Act as vendor coordination and liaison point for vendor-specific issues or requests. Maintain strong ticket hygiene in the PSA: accurate notes, time entries, troubleshooting steps, and closure summaries. Contribute to KB/SOP documentation and help reduce repeat issues. Provide friendly, clear, concise, and professional customer service via phone, email, chat, or video call, and follow up to ensure incidents and requests are fully resolved. Participate in after-hours or on-call support rotations as assigned, in accordance with company policies and applicable employment standards. What You Will Bring Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (e.g., Systems Administration, Networking) from an accredited institution. 4–7 years in IT support (MSP experience preferred) with proven Tier 2 troubleshooting capability. Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, AD/Entra ID identity concepts, and network fundamentals (DNS/DHCP/VPN/Wi-Fi). Strong problem-solving skills with an analytical and detail-oriented mindset. Strong communication and customer service skills; able to set expectations and follow through. Strong task, time-management, and organizational skills, with the ability to multitask and adapt in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Strong interpersonal skills; comfortable working with diverse clients, users, and handling challenging situations professionally. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tickets in an SLA-driven environment. A self-starter able to work well with minimal supervision and in a team environment. Nice to Have Experience with Halo PSA (or similar PSA/RMM tools), endpoint security/EDR, and backup platforms. Certifications (optional): CompTIA A+/Network+, Microsoft, or relevant vendor certifications. Salary Range 85k - 100k About The Company Onni For over half a century, Onni has been building communities for people to live, work, and play. Our success reflects our commitment to our employees and partners, and our dedication to quality construction, innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction. Our expertise expands across North America, with offices in Vancouver, Toronto, Los Angeles, Seattle, Phoenix, and Chicago. AI Use This role may involve the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support research, analysis, content development, design, reporting, or operational efficiency. Employees are expected to use AI responsibly and in compliance with company policies, data privacy requirements, confidentiality obligations, and applicable laws. All AI-generated or AI-assisted outputs must be reviewed for accuracy, quality, and appropriateness before use. Employees are also expected to disclose when AI tools have been used in the creation of work and must not present AI-generated content as solely their own original work. How To Apply Please apply through the link on the job posting and attach your resume and any other required documents. We thank all applicants for your interest in the Onni Group. Note that only those applicants under consideration will be contacted.

review_candidates.title: IT Project Engineer
review_candidates.description: Position Overview We are seeking an experienced IT Project Engineer to join our IT Projects Team. This is a hands-on technical position responsible for implementing technology solutions across a diverse client environment. The Project Engineer will work on a wide range of projects including network infrastructure deployments, server and virtualization projects, Microsoft 365 and Azure implementations, firewall and wireless deployments, technology migrations and upgrades, and the onboarding of new managed IT clients. This role is ideal for an experienced infrastructure engineer who enjoys building and implementing solutions, working directly with clients, solving complex technical problems, and taking ownership of projects from preparation through successful completion. What You'll Do Implement and complete infrastructure projects for new and existing clients. Deploy and configure firewalls, switches, wireless networks, servers, virtual machines, and cloud technologies. Perform server, network, Microsoft 365, Azure, and infrastructure migrations and upgrades. Configure networking technologies including VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs, wireless, DNS, and DHCP. Work with Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure, and related Microsoft technologies. Participate in new client onboarding, including infrastructure discovery, deployment, migration, documentation, and technical transition. Review project scopes and technical requirements prior to implementation. Prepare, stage, configure, and test equipment and solutions before deployment. Troubleshoot technical challenges encountered during implementations and migrations. Work alongside Project Management, Managed Services, NOC, SOC , Presales, and other technical teams. Communicate project status, risks, technical concerns, and potential scope changes. Maintain accurate technical documentation, project notes, configurations, and diagrams. Track project time and progress accurately within the company's PSA/project management systems. Test and validate completed solutions before production handoff. Provide technical knowledge transfer and handoff to operational support teams following project completion. Travel to client locations as required for onsite project implementations. What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional IT infrastructure experience, preferably within an MSP, consulting, systems integration, or project-based environment. Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server and Microsoft infrastructure technologies. Experience deploying and troubleshooting network infrastructure including firewalls, switches, wireless networks, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and switching. Experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and related technologies. Experience with virtualization platforms and virtual server environments. Experience performing infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and technology refresh projects. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities. Ability to independently execute assigned technical projects and recognize when escalation is necessary. Ability to read and work from Statements of Work, technical designs, implementation plans, and project documentation. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong documentation and organizational skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical clients. Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities while maintaining attention to detail. Willingness and ability to travel to client locations and occasionally perform scheduled after-hours project work. Preferred Qualifications Previous MSP or IT consulting experience. Experience participating in new-client IT onboardings and infrastructure transitions. Experience with Cisco, Meraki, Fortinet, Aruba, or similar enterprise networking technologies. Experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud infrastructure. Experience with backup, disaster recovery, security, and endpoint management technologies. Microsoft, Cisco, CompTIA, Fortinet, or other relevant industry certifications. Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Benefits Include Excellent benefit offerings including medical, dental, vision, and supplemental insurance Bonus eligible Paid time off Cellphone allowance Company paid life insurance and long-term disability insurance 401(k) plan with matching company contribution Paid training and certification opportunities Annual company store allowance What Success Looks Like A successful Project Engineer takes ownership of their technical assignments, arrives prepared for implementations, communicates issues before they become project delays, produces quality documentation, and delivers solutions that are stable, secure, and ready to transition to the teams responsible for ongoing client support. The role requires someone who can move comfortably between networking, servers, cloud technologies, client onboarding, and other infrastructure projects while maintaining a strong focus on quality, client experience, security, and successful project delivery. “Our growth is mirrored by the quality of people we have invested in.” – Louis F. Usherwood, CEO Usherwood Office Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Visit us at www.usherwood.com
